steps.zh: 先添加 marketplace（此时还没装任何东西）

steps.en: Tick the plugins you want in Discover, press enter
steps.zh: 在 Discover 页勾选想要的 plugin，回车安装

steps.en: Loads the chosen plugins' skills as on-demand design knowledge
steps.zh: 把所选 plugin 的 skill 作为按需加载的设计知识

steps.en: Unsure where to start? Say what you're working on
steps.zh: 不知道从哪开始？说出你在做什么

steps.en: Names your stage and routes you to one command plus the two that follow
steps.zh: 指出你所在的阶段，给你一条命令和随后的两条

steps.en: Run the workflow command with your context
steps.zh: 带上你的上下文跑这条工作流命令

steps.en: Chains the skills under it into one deliverable (persona, empathy map, journey map)
steps.zh: 把底层的 skill 串成一份交付物（画像、共情地图、旅程图）

value.en: The agent applies trained design judgment across the lifecycle instead of generating plausible-but-hollow output
value.zh: agent 在整条生命周期上运用训练有素的设计判断，而不是产出看着像样、实则空洞的东西

sources: README.md 'Getting started' step 2: /plugin marketplace add Owl-Listener/designer-skills
README.md 'Getting started' step 3: Type /plugin and press enter, then open the Discover tab ... press space to tick ... enter to install
README.md 'Getting started' step 4: /designer-toolkit:start-here (names the stage, gives one command and the two that follow)
README.md 'Pick your starting point' / 'Recommended install': /plugin install design-research@designer-skills; /design-research:discover runs personas, empathy map, and journey map
README.md 'What are skills and commands?': commands chain skills together to do a complete job
